title: Verwijzing naar de data van: The principle of open justice - Reporting by media and by courts
descriptions: This project investigates communication between communication officers of courts and by journalists. Establishing the views on communication between courts and the media, and on the principle of open justice in general.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]

keywords: reporting about court sessions by journalists

relations.text: NSCR; Malsch; M. Verkuylen Malsch, M. (2004). Persvoorlichting en rechtbankverslaggeving. Rechtstreeks, 2, 35-71.
